summary: The page exhibits significant layout overlap and text clipping within the MaterialTokens component on the 320px viewport, while the other components render cleanly.

issues.title: Specimen overlap and label clipping
issues.description: Specimen descriptions collide with preview shapes and metadata labels overflow container boundaries.
issues.evidence: Specimen text renders behind pill elements and 'ULTRATHIN' collides with the right container edge.
issues.suggestion: Refactor layout into a single vertical stack and adjust container padding for narrow viewports.
